name: Runner Tests Fixture - TestPage OnNewRecord Firing Count
brief: Issue #3029: a part page's OnNewRecord must run ONCE for one draft-line row, not once when the line is shown and again when a write promotes it.
description: Runner-mechanism fixture. The BC-behaviour claim is measured upstream by corpus codeunit 60358 (StefanMaron/BusinessCentral.AL.Language.Tests#266); this fixture pins the runner's own count so a regression in EnterNewRowLine / PromoteNewRowLineForWrite fails loudly here without the submodule pin having to be bumped first. Declares no application floor: everything it needs is its own.
